node.description: Identity and commissioning data of the Matter node.

network.description: How the node is reached on the network.

state.description: Where the service keeps its state (fabrics, keys, counters).

bridge.description:
The bridge role. The section's presence enables the role. It needs a build with the Cargo
feature `role-bridge`.

devices.description:
Bridged devices, one table `[devices.<id>]` per device. The id is the device's stable
key; every device names the adapter that feeds it and, in `mapping`, where the adapter
finds it. Needs the bridge role.

title: matter-rs configuration
description:
The configuration file of matter-rs.

One TOML file configures the service. Configuration and state are kept apart: the service
never writes to this file, and everything it learns at run time lives in the state directory.

vendor_id.description: Vendor id announced by the node. The default is the test vendor id `0xFFF1`.

product_id.description: Product id announced by the node.

serial_number.description: Serial number announced by the node, if any.

passcode.description:
Setup passcode for commissioning: 1 to 99999998, without the trivial values the Matter
specification forbids. A secret: write it here, or read it with `{ env = "NAME" }` or
`{ file = "PATH" }`.

discriminator.description: Discriminator that commissioners use to find the node, 0 to 4095.

NodeSection.description: Identity and commissioning data of the Matter node.

anyOf.description: The secret written into the configuration file itself.
The secret is read from an environment variable.
The secret is read from a file.

SecretValue.description: A secret: the value itself, `{ env = "NAME" }` to read it from an environment variable, or `{ file = "PATH" }` to read it from a file (surrounding whitespace is ignored).

env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the secret.

EnvSource.description: Names the environment variable that holds a secret.

file.description:
Path of the file that holds the secret. A relative path is relative to the directory of
the configuration file.

FileSource.description: Names the file that holds a secret.

interface.description: Network interface to use, by name. All interfaces when absent.

port.description: UDP port of the Matter protocol.

NetworkSection.description: How the node is reached on the network.

dir.description:
State directory. A relative path is relative to the directory of the configuration file.
When absent: `/var/lib/matter-rs` for root and `$XDG_STATE_HOME/matter-rs` (or
`~/.local/state/matter-rs`) otherwise on Linux; `%ProgramData%\matter-rs` when elevated and
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\matter-rs` otherwise on Windows.

StateSection.description: Where the service keeps its state.

journald.description: Log to the systemd journal. Linux only; ignored with a warning elsewhere.

enabled.description: Run the bridge role. Set to `false` to switch the role off without removing the section.

url.description:
Broker URL: `mqtt://host[:port]` (port 1883 when absent). `mqtts://` is reserved for a
TLS build. The URL may carry `user:password@`, but the `username` and `password` keys
are the recommended place for credentials and win over the URL.

password.description:
Password for the broker. A secret: write it here, or read it with `{ env = "NAME" }` or
`{ file = "PATH" }`.

client_id.description: MQTT client id. Default `matter-rs-<id>` with the id of this adapter table.

name.description:
The instance name of the bridge on this broker: the first topic level of its own items,
`<name>/connected`, `<name>/info`, `<name>/status/...`. Must not contain `/`, `+` or `#`.

tls_ca.description: CA certificate file (PEM) for `mqtts://` with a private CA. Reserved for a TLS build.

json_payloads.description:
Publish the bridge's status items as `{ "val": ..., "ts": ..., "lc": ... }` objects
(the mqtt-smarthome default). `false` publishes plain values.

set_json.description:
Publish `set` messages for the devices as `{ "val": ... }` objects instead of plain
values.

keep_alive.description: Seconds between keep-alive pings when nothing else is sent; `0` switches them off.

reconnect.description: How the adapter reconnects after the broker connection was lost.

oneOf.description: An MQTT broker; see the MQTT contract in `doc/mqtt.md`.

AdapterConfig.description: One adapter instance: `kind` selects the adapter, the other keys belong to it.

SecretText.description: A secret text: the text itself, `{ env = "NAME" }` to read it from an environment variable, or `{ file = "PATH" }` to read it from a file (surrounding whitespace is ignored).

env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the secret.

file.description: Path of the file that holds the secret. A relative path is relative to the directory of the configuration file.

initial.description: The delay before the first reconnect attempt, in seconds.

max.description: The longest delay between two attempts, in seconds.

Reconnect.description:
Reconnect delays after a lost broker connection: the delay starts at `initial`, doubles with
every failed attempt and never exceeds `max`. A successful connection resets it.

kind.description:
The device kind: `on-off-light`, `dimmable-light`, `color-temperature-light`,
`extended-color-light`, `on-off-plug-in-unit`, `contact-sensor`, `temperature-sensor`,
`humidity-sensor`, `pressure-sensor`, `light-sensor`, `occupancy-sensor` or
`generic-switch`. A composed device lists its kinds in `parts` instead.

adapter.description: The id of the `[adapters.<id>]` table that feeds the device.

name.description: The label controllers show; the table's id when absent.

parts.description:
The parts of a composed device, in order, each a kind with an optional label (a power
strip with two sockets and a sensor). Replaces `kind`.

mapping.description:
Where the adapter finds the device. The keys depend on the adapter's kind and are
listed per kind in the reference.

DeviceSection.description: A bridged device fed by an adapter.

kind.description: The device kind of the part, as for `kind` of the device.

label.description: The label of the part, shown as a semantic tag when several parts share a kind.

PartSection.description: One part of a composed device.
